name: panda-free-rigid
$comment: The bare Franka Emika Panda on the spatial multibond mechanics: seven compliant Revolute3D joints (held directions kt = kr = 1e+07) joined by the modified-DH joint offsets of franka_description, RigidBody3D links at their principal centre-of-mass frames with the physically feasible Gaz et al. 2019 masses, centres of mass and inertias. No drives, no friction: zero-torque Se on every joint. Released at rest from q0, the held directions on the deflections of the released motion's joint loads and swinging under gravity; compared with Pinocchio (design/validate.py). Rigid variant: the seven joints are Revolute3DRigid (the held directions are hard velocity constraints with Lagrange-multiplier reactions, so the link inertias are derivative-causal, W201 by design), and mtkcompile's index reduction keeps q and qdot per joint as the states (plan/MULTIBOND_PLAN.md section 5.7).
